newsitem.title: UK: United Utilities sells Process Equipment arm.
newsitem.headline: United Utilities sells Process Equipment arm.

text.p: UK water and electriciy giant United Utilities said on Monday that U.S. Filter Corp would be buying its process equipment unit for 125 million stg in cash and stock.

The joint statement with United States Filter Corp follows an announcement by United Utilities in March that the company planned to sell the division, which manufactures water and waste water treatment treatment equipment under brands such as Wallace and Tiernan, Envirex and General Filter.

The unit had revenues of 172 million stg in the year ended March 31 with about 64 percent generated in the U.S. and 25 percent in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and 11 percent in the Pacific Rim.
The sale is subject to U.S. antitrust regualtory approval.
